rules: NOAA country code mapping is used; do not infer country from station name.
Rank nearest candidates but do not auto-select the nearest station.
Only stations with at least one inventory element overlapping 1991-2020 are listed.
A climate candidate must have PRCP, TMAX and TMIN inventory overlap in 1991-2020; this is only an inventory screen, not proof of daily completeness.
Candidates beyond 75 km are flagged for national-network alternatives rather than silently accepted.
Review per-element daily coverage, station history, elevation and coastal/mountain representativeness before pairing.
